weight_source: structural equal weighting, not fitted to Public or outer OOF
evaluation: exact existing 166268-row eight-fold OOF, B3 Sep-Oct primary; pooled and missingness/outage are separate risk reports

if_materialized: fresh C60 three-seed full fits as needed, exact-hash L120 full reuse; independent model and CSV replay; full train-from-empty code included
